crossRefs.note: They began to be sorrowful, and to ask him one by one, “Surely not I?” And another said, “Surely not I?”
He answered them, “It is one of the twelve, he who dips with me in the dish.
They began to question among themselves, which of them it was who would do this thing.
The disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom he spoke.
He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked…

parallels.note: They began to be sorrowful, and to ask him one by one, “Surely not I?” And another said, “Surely not I?”

translations.web: They were exceedingly sorrowful, and each began to ask him, “It isn’t me, is it, Lord?”
translations.bsb: They were deeply grieved and began to ask Him one after another, “Surely not I, Lord?”
translations.kjv: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Lord, is it I?
translations.asv: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began to say unto him every one, Is it I, Lord?
